resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved by any source: three listings say destroyed in 1954, the 2018 Forest Service post says removed in 1954. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Four independent sources agree on the 1931 build and the 1954 end date, but the wording conflicts (destroyed vs removed). The 2018 USFS Facebook post also carries a 1938 interior photo of Wayne Tautfest (Doland Broker photograph, USFS collection); no image URL was captured, so no photos entry. No staffing beyond that photo and no fire records were found. The NFSL Fixed Fire Detection PDF and the Clearwater Story book were cached but had no Gold Hill line.
